tools.name: make_plot_link
tools.description: Check a Graph Paper plot document and return the link that opens it. The link opens the plot as an editable draft in Graph Paper (https://graph-paper.io); the reader needs no account. Give the document as a JSON object in the format of get_plot_format. If the document has errors, the result lists ea

tools.name: get_plot_format
tools.description: Return the reference of the Graph Paper plot document format, as Markdown: every field of a plot document, the series types, the limits, and complete examples. Give section to get one section only (a heading of the page, such as "Variables" or "2D Series Types"); an unknown section returns the list

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: Return the example plot documents of the Graph Paper format page, each with its title and its JSON. Each one is a valid document that make_plot_link accepts; start from the one closest to what you want.
